mapper.sql: select t.ticket_id, t.metric_code, t.title, t.status, t.priority, t.dept_id, t.subject_id, t.ref_json, t.owner_by, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, d.dept_name, s.subject_name from spas_quality_ticket t left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = t.dept_id left join spas_subject s on s.subject_id = t.subject_id
mapper.delete: delete from spas_quality_ticket where ticket_id in #{id}
